subject: Could we shuffle tomorrow?
text: Hey, I know we set aside time tomorrow, but I'm still halfway through that project outline, and I don't want it hovering over us. If you're flexible, could we push it to Friday instead? I'll be much more relaxed by then, and I owe you a coffee for the last-minute shuffle. Let me know if that works, and if Friday feels crowded, I can keep Monday open for whatever you'd prefer. Thanks for understanding, and hope your week goes smoother than mine!
